signal_group: own block identity and public attributes
source_reads: getBlockWithoutAttributes, getBlockAttributes, block type, default class name, reusable status, validity, metadata.blockVisibility, metadata.patternName-adjacent variation state, bindable attributes
ordinary_text_update_effect: changes only for the edited block during ordinary paragraph typing; unrelated blocks should keep the same own identity/attribute result
must_invalidate_for: same-client attribute updates, block replacement, validity changes, className changes, metadata visibility/binding changes, block name/type changes, and active variation changes
stale_failure_mode: editor.BlockListBlock filters and PrivateBlockContext consumers see stale block/attributes/name/title/visibility/binding data for the block whose own state changed
prototype_implication: Do not use a selection-only guard. The prototype needs a per-clientId own-block dependency boundary so the edited block updates while unrelated blocks reuse their prior output.

signal_group: selection, caret, overlay, and drag state
source_reads: isBlockSelected, hasSelectedInnerBlock, isFirstMultiSelectedBlock, getMultiSelectedBlockClientIds, getSelectedBlocksInitialCaretPosition, isBlockHighlighted, isBlockBeingDragged, isDragging, active block overlay, full/partial multi-selection
ordinary_text_update_effect: mostly unchanged after the first typed key, but not invariant across real editing
must_invalidate_for: select, deselect, multi-select, caret movement, child selection, drag start/end, overlay activation, highlight changes, and selection-unmergeable state changes
stale_failure_mode: wrong controls, outline, overlay, drag affordance, selected styling, initial caret, or synchronous rendering behavior
prototype_implication: The boundary must include a selection/interaction version that invalidates selected blocks, ancestors of selected blocks, and drag/overlay participants.

source_reads: getBlockIndex, getBlocksByName, getParentSectionBlock, isSectionBlock, getBlockName for multi-selected blocks, rootClientId/root template lock
must_invalidate_for: insert, remove, move, duplicate/unique-block changes, root changes, section-block parent changes, and root template-lock changes
stale_failure_mode: stale index, stale originalBlockClientId warning, incorrect section controls, or wrong locked/movable/removable state
prototype_implication: The prototype needs a structural/root version, not only own-attribute and selection keys.

source_reads: getBlockEditingMode for client/root, canRemoveBlock, canMoveBlock, getTemplateLock, getEditedContentOnlySection, isSelectionEnabled, isBlockSubtreeDisabled, block support multiple/expose-controls
must_invalidate_for: template lock, editing mode, content-only section, permission/capability, block support, and subtree-disabled changes
stale_failure_mode: stale editability, missing disabled outline, incorrect remove/move controls, or stale parent controls
prototype_implication: Guard output must include editing/capability versions or explicitly prove those selectors are stable for the skipped action class.

signal_group: global settings, device, preview, and layout context
source_reads: getSettings supportsLayout/isPreviewMode/device type/bindable attributes, blockVisibility hook input, block default class name
must_invalidate_for: preview-mode toggles, device type changes, block-editor settings changes, theme/layout support changes, binding-support settings changes, and visibility metadata changes
stale_failure_mode: stale preview context, wrong wrapper class, stale visibility hiding, or stale binding affordance state
prototype_implication: Keep settings/device/preview as separate invalidation keys; the pattern-override patch does not remove broader block-editor binding UI responsibilities.

source_reads: when clientId is absent: isZoomOut and getSectionRootClientId
must_invalidate_for: zoom in/out, auto-scaled zoom, and section-root changes
stale_failure_mode: root and section block lists both behave as active drop zones or both become disabled
prototype_implication: Root useInnerBlocksProps can be keyed by zoom/section-root state; ordinary text should not invalidate it.

signal_group: block identity, parent, type, and toolbar capture
ordinary_text_update_effect: unchanged by ordinary paragraph text unless the edited block is replaced or transformed
must_invalidate_for: block transform/replacement, parent/root move, block type registration/support changes, and parent changes
stale_failure_mode: wrong inner block component, stale toolbar capture, stale parentClientId, or wrong block type passed to InnerBlocks
prototype_implication: Use a clientId identity/root key; do not recompute this path for unrelated text attribute changes.

source_reads: getBlockSettings(clientId, 'layout'), block settings inherited from current block or ancestors, global __experimentalFeatures layout
ordinary_text_update_effect: unchanged by ordinary text attributes, but can change when layout/settings attributes on the block or ancestors change
must_invalidate_for: layout attribute changes, ancestor settings changes, theme/global settings changes, and block supports settings changes
stale_failure_mode: stale layout class/default layout, incorrect child layout behavior, or stale manual placement handling
prototype_implication: The key must include layout/settings dependencies; getBlockSettings reads attributes of candidate ancestors, so an attributes-blind skip would be unsafe.

signal_group: editing mode, template lock, zoom, and drop-zone disablement
must_invalidate_for: editing-mode changes, parent template-lock changes, zoom changes, section-root changes, and drop-zone option changes
stale_failure_mode: drop zone accepts where it should not, refuses valid drops, or renders wrong lock state
prototype_implication: The prototype must include editability/template/zoom dependencies and behavior tests for drop-zone state.
